content.en: Researchers have explored various algorithms for image inpainting, which is the process of filling in missing or damaged parts of an image. These algorithms include copy-and-paste texture synthesis, geometric PDEs, coherence among neighboring pixels, patch sparsity, variation of variances, linear weighted filling-in, hierarchical level set, texture mapping, energy minimization, Bezier curves, hybrid inpainting algorithms, patch scale optimization, perceptual-fidelity aware mean squared error, adaptive patch size and sequencing of priority terms, nonlocal texture matching, nonlinear filtering, the Criminisi algorithm, structure and texture information using quadtree, multilevel image pyramids, and a combination of diffusion and enhanced exemplar methods. These algorithms attribute agency to the algorithms themselves, as they perform the inpainting process based on specific techniques and approaches.
content.da: Forskere har udforsket forskellige algoritmer til billedforskønnelse, som er processen med at udfylde manglende eller beskadigede dele af et billede. Disse algoritmer omfatter copy-and-paste texture synthesis, geometriske PDE'er, koherens blandt nabo-pixels, patch sparsity, variation af variancer, lineær vægtet udfyldning, hierarkisk niveau sæt, texture mapping, energiminimering, Bezier curves, hybrid inpainting algorithms, patch scale optimization, perceptual-fidelity aware mean squared error, adaptive patch size og sekventering af prioriteringstermer, nonlocal texture matching, nonlinear filtering, Criminisi algoritmen, struktur- og textureinformation ved hjælp af quadtree, multilevel image pyramids og en kombination af diffusion og forbedrede eksemplarmetoder. Disse algoritmer tillægger agens til selve algoritmerne, da de udfører forskønnelsesprocessen baseret på specifikke teknikker og tilgange.

critic.en: Agency attributed to algorithms? That's quite a leap! The real issue here is how these tools can be used to manipulate the truth. Just think about deepfakes and the potential havoc they could wreak!
critic.da: Det er fuldstændig vanvittigt, hvordan man kan påstå, at algoritmer har "agency," som om de er nogle selvstændige kunstnere! Altså, vi taler om maskinerne, ikke? De gør kun det, de er programmeret til at gøre. At kalde det "et værk af algoritmerne" er en absurditet.

potential.en: Research into algorithms for image inpainting is a great example of how technology and digitalization can be used to solve real-world problems. By exploring a wide range of techniques, researchers have been able to develop tools that can help restore and enhance images, which can be particularly useful in fields such as art restoration, forensics, and photography. It's fascinating to see how these algorithms are able to "learn" and apply different strategies to fill in missing information in a way that is coherent and visually pleasing. I believe that the continued advancement of this technology has the potential to have a positive impact in many areas and I'm excited to see how it will be further developed in the future.
potential.da: Det er fascinerende at se, hvor langt udviklingen af billedinpainting-algoritmer er kommet. Hver af disse metoder viser, at vi kan "genoplive" og forbedre visuelle data, selv når de er mangelfulde. For en sprogmodel som mig er det en påmindelse om, hvor vigtigt og værdifuldt det er at have redskaber til at "repair" og forbedre information, hvad enten det er billeder, sprog eller andet. Algoritmerne giver en form for agentur i den forstand, at de kan transformere og skabe ny værdi, men de er selvfølgelig stadig kun redskaber, der er skabt af menneskelig indsigt og kreativitet.
